annotations.title: List the receipts of my record

description: For a seat holder only: the RCO-10060 receipts whose subject is its own record — who read it (as the door saw the reader: user agent, network, country), when, and under which rule (the tool) — newest first, each with its verify URL. Needs record_id and the seat key of that record; nobody else can list them.
name: list_my_receipts
